form.name: Sarah Jones
form.context: Our welcome series is converting at 1.2% and I know it should be triple that. Black Friday is in 6 months and I cannot show up to a planning meeting without a working welcome flow. We have no in-house email person.

form.name: Marcus Webb
form.context: Inherited this AC account from a contractor who left in January. Not sure what's running, what's broken, what's just dead weight. Want to know what I'm sitting on before I spend any more money on it.

form.name: Priya Patel
form.context: We have two AC accounts for clients who aren't getting the results they were promised. I need someone senior to get on calls with our internal team weekly and tell us what we're missing. Don't need them to build — we have builders.

form.name: Jamal Carter
form.context: Mailchimp is killing us on segmentation and abandoned cart isn't really working the way we set it up. Heard AC is more flexible. Need someone to handle the migration end-to-end because if I screw up the customer data we're in trouble.

form.name: Alex Kim
form.context: We've been on AC for 14 months. Open rates dropped from 38% to 21% over the last 3 months and I can't find the cause. Want a proper diagnostic, not a hour-long discovery call. Will pay for the structured output.

form.name: Robin Lee
form.context: Just heard about AC from a podcast. Not sure if I need a full ESP yet.

form.name: Diana Park
form.context: Black Friday revenue dropped 42% YoY. Win-back sequences haven't been touched since 2024. Engagement is in the basement. We have a team of 3 marketers but none of them know AC at this scale. Need this fixed before Q4 planning starts in 6 weeks.
